first_runtime_asset.visual_review: passed four final exported GLB views against four unchanged raw-source views
first_runtime_asset.deployment_scope: One or two sparse examples per region; dense regular-property kit is authored separately.

first_completed_inference.memory_boundary: Completed on RTX 5070 Ti under Windows WDDM, with measured allocation exceeding physical VRAM and shared-memory spill. This is not a claim of fitting exclusively in 16 GiB dedicated VRAM.
first_completed_inference.inputs: Three independent square RGBA images, copied byte-for-byte from ImageGen outputs; no montage input.
first_completed_inference.camera_calibration: Assumed standard 0/90/180 degree orbit at 20 degree FOV, not measured cameras.

input_requirements: Separate images of the same consistent object; no montage input
transforms.json with per-frame 4x4 camera-to-world matrix and horizontal camera_angle_x
One consistent mesh_scale/framing; no independent object crop/resize
First frame is canonical front, world Z up, camera at (0,-d,0)
RGBA alpha supported; unmasked inputs require the original matting model
reference_board_boundary: ImageGen orthographic design boards are useful modeling references but do not contain measured perspective camera matrices. A guessed 20-degree orbit may run but is an assumed-camera reconstruction, not exact calibrated multi-view reproduction.
current_project_runner: art/themed-city-kit/tools/run_pixal_multiview.py calls actual inference_mv.py and run_mv with pipeline_mv.json and four native *_mv flow weights. A separate run_mv-aware lifetime adapter retires completed stages without changing native sampling values. First full inference completed successfully; eight CPU lifetime checks passed.
memory_evidence: Native MV code projects views sequentially and averages in place, but DINO batches B*V. First completed native trial peaked at 16.37 GiB CUDA allocation and 22.23 GiB reserved, exceeding 15.92 GiB physical VRAM; Windows shared memory allowed completion. A transient unrelated large Node working set also caused RAM pressure. No user programs were closed.

projection_cache_cleanup: After each complete native conditioner return, only unused CUDA allocator blocks are released. Returned object and live tensor values remain unchanged. This improves later-stage headroom but does not reduce the measured dense-projection peak below physical VRAM.
